Port src/log.c to the Rust module `kvconf_rs::log` (rust/kvconf_rs/src/log.rs, safe Rust).

edits.search: //! Ported from src/log.c (CodeCoreMorph, D-68).
//! The C functions of src/log.c, exported under their names over `crate::log`.

# The C names this port moved to Rust, and the Rust items that took them over (CodeCoreMorph,
# D-68). One entry per function and variable a ported source file exports:
#
#   [[symbol]]
#   c = "htab_add"
#   rust = "wf_rs::htab::Table::add"    # or a list of paths
#   note = "..."    # optional: behavior the port couldn't keep, or why rust is empty
edits.replace:
# The C names this port moved to Rust, and the Rust items that took them over (CodeCoreMorph,
# D-68). One entry per function and variable a ported source file exports:
#
#   [[symbol]]
#   c = "htab_add"
#   rust = "wf_rs::htab::Table::add"    # or a list of paths
#   note = "..."    # optional: behavior the port couldn't keep, or why rust is empty

[[symbol]]
c = "kv_options_init"
rust = "kvconf_rs::log::Options"
note = "Options::default; the C export fills C's struct with the same defaults."

[[symbol]]
c = "kv_level_name"
rust = "kvconf_rs::log::level_name"

[[symbol]]
c = "kv_strerror"
rust = ["kvconf_rs::log::strerror", "kvconf_rs::log::Error"]

[[symbol]]
c = "kv_log_write"
rust = "kvconf_rs::log::Options::write"

[[symbol]]
c = "kv_log"
rust = "kvconf_rs::log::Options::log"
note = "Stays C until the retirement: stable Rust can't define a variadic function. It formats with vsnprintf and calls kv_log_write; Rust code passes format_args!."

[[symbol]]
c = "kv_vlog"
rust = "kvconf_rs::log::Options::log"
note = "Stays C until the retirement, as kv_log: it takes a va_list."

arguments.summary: Port src/log.c to kvconf_rs::log: the options' defaults, level names, status messages (an Error enum for the codes) and the sink, which the C export keeps calling with the C context. kv_log and kv_vlog stay in src/log.c, as stable Rust can't define them: they only format the message (vsnprintf, cut at KV_MESSAGE_MAX) and call kv_log_write.
review_notes: kv_vlog no longer checks the level before formatting: kv_log_write drops the message instead, so a dropped message is formatted first. Nothing else changes.

arguments.summary: Retire the C: the crate keeps what Rust code uses. Gone with the bridge: C's comparisons without case (strutil::casecmp and prefix_casecmp; Rust compares with eq_ignore_ascii_case), the growth policy of C's entry array (doc::grown) and Set::code, C's return value. The symbol map says where those went, and make:tests/dump, which ran tests/dump.sh, maps to kvdump's integration tests, which compare the same files.
